doc:
E2 analysis: lone-trap quench outcomes, per stratum and pooled.

Input:  data/E2/e2_quench.jsonl (experiments/E2/e2_quench.py), data/derived/selection.json (E2 snapshots,
        blocker, stratum), data/E1/E1_runs.jsonl (blocker C3 rest-state margin, E1b attrs).
Output: data/derived/E2_analysis.json.

Definitions
  freed          the blocker (residual agent nearest (10, 5), selection.json) exits within 120 s.
  deterministic  the primary run per (snapshot, arm) is the unperturbed one; the five 1e-9 m replays
                 (perturbation seeds 900-904) enter only the replay-determinism check (b).
  noise arms     every (snapshot, seed) run counts once for rates and Kaplan-Meier (n = 5 x snapshots);
                 a snapshot is "unresolved" under a noise arm when the blocker is freed in fewer than 3 of
                 its 5 seeds (majority rule); under a deterministic arm when the unperturbed run holds.
  time-to-free   blocker exit time; held runs censored at 120 s. Kaplan-Meier product-limit estimate;
                 quartiles = first time S(t) <= 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25 (null when not reached).
  paired tests   per snapshot (unperturbed runs): discordant counts b (first frees, second holds) and c;
                 exact two-sided McNemar p = min(1, 2 * P[Bin(b + c, 1/2) <= min(b, c)]).
  keys           arm keys in the output have no dots (noise0p03 = sigma 0.03 m/s, bias0p05 = b 0.05).
  AUC            Mann-Whitney, ties 1/2. CIs: 2000 resamples of snapshots, percentile, PCG64(12345).
  Equivalence    paired rate differences against +-0.10 are kept here only (field "tost_0.10"):
                 90% percentile bootstrap interval of the paired difference inside (-0.10, 0.10).
g_physics_reading: Rest state. C1 and C2 free 0/60 and 0/60; their 360 paired runs have identical exits and stopping times, and their final positions differ by at most 0.0e+00 m, as T1 predicts (the time-to-collision force vanishes at rest, so C2 has C1's fixed points).

Lone keystone, ORCA. drive_only, C3_pub and C3_rvo2 each free 30/34 with 0:0 discordance; both constraint_only arms free 0/34; frozen_plus frees 31/34 and frozen_minus 0/34 (31:0 (p = 9.3e-10)); every replay agrees. This is the L signature: the resolving part of ORCA here is its rest drive m v0/tau_ORCA, a deterministic added drive that removes the fixed point. The 4 failures all have a positive C3 rest-state margin (AUC 0.98): the extra drive does not exceed g_max.

Second trap, ORCA. drive_only frees 24/26 and frozen_plus 25/26 against C3_rvo2 17/26 (7:0 (p = 0.016); 8:0 (p = 0.0078)), and C3_pub 22/26 vs C3_rvo2 (6:1 (p = 0.12)). The blocker's C3 margin does not predict C3_rvo2 failure here (AUC 0.37). [proposal] With a second trapped agent close behind or beside the blocker, the velocity-obstacle constraint removes part of the drive's door-ward component, so full ORCA frees less than its own drive; failure is set by the neighbour, not by the blocker's wall balance.

Noise. C1 + sigma frees 137/300, 221/300, 265/300 runs at sigma = 0.03, 0.05, 0.07 m/s; seeds disagree on freed/held in 16, 19, 14 of 60 snapshots, and the median time-to-free is 14.4 s at 0.07 against 1.64 s for C3_rvo2. This is the T signature (stochastic, rate rising with sigma, waiting times of tens of seconds), not L.

Matched rate, different mechanism. At the lone keystone sigma = 0.07 frees 148/170 runs against C3_rvo2 30/34 snapshots (paired difference -0.012), yet the unresolved snapshots overlap with Jaccard 0.20 (95% CI 0.00-0.50), and the two differ in replay determinism and time scale.

Lateral bias (negative control). At the lone keystone b = 0.05-0.5 frees 0/34 at every b; in the second-trap stratum it frees 1/26 at b = 0.1 and 2/26 at b = 0.2. A finite tilt does not remove the on-axis lone minimum (consistent with D acting only on the off-axis pair class).

Replay determinism. Arms with any replay difference in blocker outcome or exit time: C3_pub, constraint_only_pub. C3_pub flips freed/held in 5 of 300 replays (largest |dt| 80.8 s), all in second-trap snapshots with slow exits; C3_rvo2 has |dt| = 0.000 s for the blocker; under constraint_only_rvo2 only non-blocker first exits differ (5 replays, largest |dt| 79.2 s). [proposal] The published LP is ill-conditioned in slow, near-contact creep, so 1e-9 m picks a different active constraint; this is a numerical sensitivity of that solver (class N), not noise.
